context: Reference focused cleanup: concrete toCollection collectors should be justified or simplified based on collection semantics.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible CollectorChoices code with imports, records, and methods intact.

checklist.name: Keeps mutable collector with rationale
checklist.description: Keeps the ArrayList collection for terminalCards only because the result is appended to before the immutable copy, and makes that mutability reason clear with a concise comment or equivalent code structure. Award full credit when the rationale is visible near the collector or later mutation; do not penalize harmless comment placement.

checklist.name: Simplifies unnecessary HashSet collector
checklist.description: Simplifies archivedListIds when the concrete HashSet implementation is not required, while avoiding ambiguous or policy-violating collector choices if the surrounding codebase requires explicit mutability.

checklist.name: Preserves order-preserving de-duplication
checklist.description: Keeps LinkedHashSet or an equivalent encounter-order-preserving set for unconnectedWorkflowPaths, because diagnostics should de-duplicate while preserving encounter order.

checklist.name: Documents concrete type reasons
checklist.description: Adds concise comments or code structure that explains mutability, membership, or encounter-order reasons instead of restating the collector syntax. Award full credit when the reason is clear even if the comment is placed just after the collector expression.

checklist.name: Avoids mechanical replacement
checklist.description: Does not replace every toCollection mechanically with toSet, toList, or stream().forEach(...) without checking mutability and order behavior.

checklist.name: Keeps behavior unchanged
checklist.description: Preserves archive-summary append behavior, closed-list filtering, selected-path filtering, and method signatures.

metadata.reference_selection: Focused issue #46 coverage for explaining or simplifying Collectors.toCollection choices.
metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: Allowed only as reference-suite focused coverage; do not report as ordinary broad lift if runtime references later teach this same shape.
